flowchart-direction-line.comment: The direction line, From the current position, try TB, BT, RL, LR, TD in that order, taking the last direction for the selected family. Earlier statement rules win at the same position by block pattern order; indentation can expose this rule before those statements. No start anchor is needed: the rule reads the remaining line from the first position at which no earlier rule applies, including after an earlier unit. Empty or all-whitespace direction text has no string scope. Follows flowchart.md#the-statement-context.
